<!DOCTYPE html>
<style>
  html, body, div, iframe { border: 0; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; width: 100%; }
</style>
<iframe
  data-src="{{player}}"
  scrolling="no"
  allowfullscreen
  allow="autoplay; fullscreen; web-share"
  sandbox="allow-popups allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-presentation">
</iframe>
<script nonce="{{nonce}}">
  if (window !== window.top) {
    const playerFrame = document.querySelector('iframe');
    playerFrame.setAttribute('src', playerFrame.getAttribute('data-src'));
  }
</script>
